title: Client Level Segregation of Advisory and Distribution Activities
summary: Ensure client level segregation at IA’s group/family level, where existing clients cannot avail both advisory and distribution services within the same group/family.
required_action: Adopt a compliance and monitoring process for client level segregation.
evidence: Documentation of the adopted compliance and monitoring process, including records of onboarding new clients and handling existing clients.
source_circular: SEBI/HO/IMD/DF1/CIR/P/2020/182 dated September 23, 2020 and SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/003 dated January 08, 2025
verbatim_text: To ensure client level segregation at IA’s group/family level, as per Regulation 22(5) of the IA Regulations, following compliance and monitoring process shall be adopted: (a) Existing clients, who wish to take advisory services, will not be eligible for availing distribution services within the group/family of IA. Similarly, existing clients who wish to take distribution services will not be eligible for availing advisory services within the group/family of IA. (b) A new client will be eligible to avail either advisory or distribution services within the group/family of IA. However, the option to avail either advisory services or distribution services shall be made available to such client at the time of on boarding. (c) Client under these guidelines shall include individual client or non-individual client. (d) The client shall have discretion to continue holding assets prior to the applicability of this segregation under the existing advisory/distribution arrangement. However, the client shall not be forced to liquidate/switch such existing holdings.

title: Provide Guidance on Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide guidance to their clients regarding the optional ‘Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism for IA and RA’ (CeFCoM).
trigger: When providing investment advice or fee collection mechanisms.
required_action: Provide guidance on CeFCoM to clients.
evidence: Documentation of communication with clients regarding CeFCoM.
verbatim_text: IAs shall also provide guidance to their clients in the agreement on the optional ‘Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism for IA and RA’ (CeFCoM).

title: Include Additional Terms and Conditions
summary: Investment Advisers can include additional terms and conditions in the agreement without diluting existing regulations.
required_action: Include additional terms and conditions as per IA Regulations and SEBI circulars.
evidence: Copies of updated client agreements.
verbatim_text: IA can also include additional terms and conditions in the agreement without diluting the provisions of the IA Regulations and amendments thereto as well as circulars issued thereunder.

title: Ensure Client Signature Before Providing Advice or Charging Fees
summary: Investment Advisers must ensure that clients have signed the agreement and provided a copy before providing investment advice or charging fees.
trigger: When providing investment advice or charging fees from clients.
required_action: Ensure client has signed the agreement and provided a copy.
evidence: Copies of signed agreements with clients.
verbatim_text: IA shall ensure that neither any investment advice is rendered nor any fee is charged until the client has signed the aforesaid agreement and provided copy of signed agreement to the client.

title: Charge Fees According to Specified Modes
summary: Investment Advisers can charge fees under two modes: Assets under Advice (AUA) mode and Fixed fee mode.
required_action: Charge fees according to the specified modes.
evidence: Documentation of fee charges and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: IAs shall be entitled to charge fees from a client in the manner as specified by SEBI. Accordingly, IAs can charge fees under two modes, namely, (i) Assets under Advice (‘AUA’) mode, which is subject to a limit of 2.5 per cent of AUA per annum per family of client across all services offered by IA, and (ii) Fixed fee mode, which is subject to a specified fee limit (earlier limit ₹1,25,000) per annum per family of client across all services offered by IA.

title: Revised Fixed Fee Mode Limit
summary: Investment Advisers can now charge a maximum fee of ₹1,51,000 per annum under the fixed fee mode.
required_action: Ensure that the fee charged does not exceed ₹1,51,000 per annum.
evidence: Documentation of fee charges and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: The maximum fee that may be charged by the IA under the fixed fee mode now stands revised and shall not exceed ₹1,51,000 per annum per family of client. The fee limit shall be revised and announced by IAASB once in three years based on the Cost Inflation Index (CII) after due consultation with SEBI.

title: Change Fee Mode Flexibility
summary: Investment Advisers can now change fee mode for a client at any time without restriction on the minimum period between two changes.
trigger: When changing fee modes with clients.
required_action: Change fee mode as per revised regulations.
evidence: Documentation of fee mode changes and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: In order to provide more flexibility in charging of fees, IAs have now been allowed to change the fee mode for a client at any time, without restriction on the minimum period between two fee mode changes. The maximum fee that can be charged by the IA shall, however, not exceed the higher of fee limit under the fixed fee mode or 2.5 per cent of AUA per annum per family of client.

title: Do Not Include Statutory Charges in Fee Limits
summary: Investment Advisers must ensure that statutory charges are not included in the fee limits.
required_action: Ensure that statutory charges are excluded from fee calculations.
evidence: Documentation of fee charges and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: The fee limits do not include statutory charges.

title: Deduct Pre-existing Distribution Arrangements from AUA
summary: Investment Advisers must deduct any portion of AUA held under pre-existing distribution arrangements with other entities.
trigger: When calculating AUA for fee charging purposes.
required_action: Deduct pre-existing distribution arrangements from AUA.
evidence: Documentation of AUA calculations and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: Any portion of AUA held by the client under any pre-existing distribution arrangement with any entity shall be deducted from AUA for the purpose of charging fee by the IA.

title: Scope of Investment Advice Under SEBI Regulations
summary: Investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI falls under the IA Regulations.
trigger: When providing investment advice or services.
required_action: Ensure that investment advice provided is within the scope of SEBI regulations.
evidence: Documentation of investment advice and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
verbatim_text: In terms of revised scope of the ‘investment advice’ under Regulation 2(1)(l) of the IA Regulations, Investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI shall only fall under the purview of IA Regulations.

title: Charge Fees Based on Net Asset Value
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must charge fees based on the aggregate net asset value of securities under SEBI's purview.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 2(1)(ac) of IA Regulations
required_action: Charge fees in accordance with the specified formula.
evidence: Fee calculation records and client agreements.
verbatim_text: For the purpose of charging fee under AUA mode, AUA shall mean the aggregate net asset value of securities under the purview of SEBI. Accordingly, it is clarified that the limits on fee chargeable to clients by IAs shall be applicable only in respect of investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI.

title: Charge Fees for a Maximum of One Year in Advance
summary: IAs may charge fees in advance, but such advance shall not exceed one year.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 2(1)(h) of IA Regulations
required_action: Charge fees for a maximum period of one year in advance and refund the unexpired portion upon premature termination.
evidence: Fee calculation records, client agreements, and refund documentation.
verbatim_text: If agreed by the client, IAs may charge fees in advance, however, such advance shall not exceed fees for a period of one year. In the event of pre-mature termination of the IA services in terms of agreement, the client shall be refunded the fees for unexpired period. However, IA may retain a maximum breakage fee of not greater than one-quarter fee.

title: Refund Unexpired Fees Upon Premature Termination
summary: IAs must refund the unexpired portion of fees upon premature termination of services.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 2(1)(h) of IA Regulations
required_action: Refund the unexpired portion of fees to clients upon premature termination of services.
evidence: Fee calculation records, client agreements, and refund documentation.
verbatim_text: In the event of pre-mature termination of the IA services in terms of agreement, the client shall be refunded the fees for unexpired period. However, IA may retain a maximum breakage fee of not greater than one-quarter fee.

title: Limit and Mode of Fees for Non-Individual Clients and Accredited Investors
summary: Fee-related terms and conditions are governed through bilaterally negotiated contractual terms for non-individual clients and accredited investors.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 2(1)(i) of IA Regulations
required_action: Negotiate fee-related terms with non-individual clients and accredited investors through contractual agreements.
evidence: Fee calculation records, client agreements, and negotiation documentation.
verbatim_text: In case of non-individual clients and accredited investors, fee related terms and conditions shall be governed through bilaterally negotiated contractual terms.

title: Maintain Deposit Based on Number of Clients
summary: IAs must maintain a deposit based on the number of clients they have.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
required_action: Maintain a deposit with a scheduled bank as specified by SEBI.
evidence: Bank statements and records of deposit maintenance.
verbatim_text: As per Regulation 8 of the IA Regulations, an investment adviser shall maintain a deposit of such sum, as specified by SEBI from time to time. The deposit requirements shall be based on the maximum number of clients of IA on any day of the previous financial year, as under:

title: Deposit Maintenance with Scheduled Bank and Lien
summary: IAs must maintain their deposit with a scheduled bank marked as lien in favor of IAASB.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
required_action: Maintain the deposit with a scheduled bank and mark it as lien in favor of IAASB.
evidence: Bank statements and records of deposit maintenance.
verbatim_text: The deposit shall be maintained with a scheduled bank marked as lien in favor of Investment Adviser Administration and Supervisory body (IAASB), in the manner and form as may be specified by IAASB.

title: Review Deposit Requirements Periodically
summary: IAs must review their deposit requirements periodically based on changes in the number of clients.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
required_action: Review and adjust the deposit amount as necessary based on the maximum number of clients on any day in the previous financial year.
evidence: Bank statements, records of review, and adjustment documentation.
verbatim_text: The deposit amount may be revised for any change in applicable amount of deposit, based on the maximum number of clients on any day in the previous financial year, latest by 30th April of the subsequent financial year.

title: Compliance with Deposit Requirement by Existing IAs
summary: Existing IAs must comply with the deposit requirement by September 30, 2025.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
required_action: Comply with the deposit requirement as specified by SEBI.
evidence: Bank statements and records of deposit maintenance.
verbatim_text: Existing IAs, as on January 8, 2025, shall comply with the deposit requirement by September 30, 2025.

title: Enhanced Qualification and Experience Requirement
summary: IAs must meet enhanced qualification and experience requirements as per the SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020.
trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
required_action: Meet the enhanced qualification and experience requirements as specified by SEBI.
evidence: Qualification certificates, professional records, and experience documentation.
verbatim_text: Vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020, enhanced qualification and experience requirement were introduced.

title: Comply with Enhanced Qualification and Experience Requirement
summary: Individual investment advisers or principal officers of non-individual investment advisers must meet the enhanced qualification and experience requirements.
required_action: Comply with the enhanced qualification and experience requirement within a period of five years i.e. up to September 30, 2025.
evidence: Documentation proving compliance with the required qualifications and experience.
verbatim_text: "(a) Vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020, enhanced qualification and experience requirement were introduced under Regulation 7 of the IA Regulations for individual investment adviser or a principal officer of a non-individual investment adviser and persons associated with investment advice. Existing Individual investment advisers or principal officer of a non-individual investment adviser and persons associated with investment advice as on September 30, 2020 were required to comply with the enhanced qualification and experience requirement within a period of five years i.e. up to September 30, 2025 (initial time period of three years was subsequently extended for another two years)."

title: Comply with Revised Qualification Criteria
summary: Individual investment advisers or principal officers of non-individual investment advisers must meet the revised qualification criteria as per current regulation.
required_action: Comply with the revised qualification criteria under Regulation 7 of the IA Regulations effective from December 16, 2024.
evidence: Documentation proving compliance with the required qualifications.
verbatim_text: "(b) Subsequently, vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2024, experience requirement has been removed and qualification requirement has been relaxed under Regulation 7 of the IA Regulations, effective from December 16, 2024. For Individual investment advisers or principal officer of a non-individual IA as on September 30, 2020, who meet the revised qualification criteria as per current regulation shall not be required to comply with enhanced qualification and experience requirement as mandated vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020."

title: Apply for In-Principle Registration as Non-Individual Investment Advisor
summary: An individual IA must apply for in-principle registration as non-individual IA if the number of clients exceeds three hundred or the fee collected during the financial year exceeds three crore rupees.
trigger: Number of clients exceed 300 at any point of time or fee collected during the financial year exceeds 3 crore rupees, whichever is earlier
required_action: Apply for in-principle registration as non-individual IA using FORM-A.
evidence: Application form and supporting documents submitted to SEBI.
verbatim_text: "(a) As per Regulation 13(e) of the IA Regulations, an individual IA, whose number of clients exceed three hundred at any point of time or the fee collected during the financial year exceeds three crore rupees, whichever is earlier, is required to apply for in-principle registration as non-individual IA."

title: Submit Application and Required Documents
summary: An individual IA must submit the application for in-principle registration along with the requisite fee.
trigger: Application for in-principle registration as non-individual IA is made
required_action: Submit the application and required documents to SEBI.
evidence: Submission of FORM-A with all necessary documents and fees.
verbatim_text: "(b) Such application for registration shall be made in FORM-A as per the IA Regulations, along with the requisite fee and same shall be assessed in accordance with the provisions of the IA Regulations and amendments thereto as well as circulars issued thereunder."

title: Comply with Number of Clients Limit
summary: The number of clients for an individual IA must not exceed 300 at any point in time.
trigger: Number of client agreements in force exceeds 300 on any day
required_action: Ensure the number of clients does not exceed 300.
evidence: Records showing the current number of active client agreements.
verbatim_text: "(c) The “number of clients” shall mean number of client agreements in force at any point of time i.e. limit of 300 clients not to be exceeded on any day."

title: Complete Transition Process within Three Months
summary: An individual IA must complete the transition process from individual IA to non-individual IA within three months of applying for in-principle registration.
trigger: Application for in-principle registration as non-individual IA is made
required_action: Complete the transition process within three months.
evidence: Documentation proving completion of the transition process.
verbatim_text: "(d) In order to ease the process of transition from individual IA to non-individual IA, an individual IA shall initially be required to apply for grant of in-principle registration as non-individual IA which shall be valid for a period of up to three months within which time, the IA is required to complete the transition process. On completion of transition within the time limit, the IA shall surrender his individual IA registration certificate and will be granted final registration as non-individual IA subject to c"

title: Maintain Arms-Length Relationship Between IA and RA Activities
summary: Ensure that investment advisory services and research services are clearly segregated from each other.
trigger: Registration as Investment Adviser and Research Analyst
required_action: Provide an undertaking stating the arms-length relationship between IA and RA activities.
evidence: Undertaking document signed by the IA/RA.
verbatim_text: Such IA/RA shall provide an undertaking stating that it shall maintain arms-length relationship between its activity as IA and RA and shall ensure that its investment advisory services and research services are clearly segregated from each other.

title: Provide prominent disclaimer for part-time IAs
summary: Part-time Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide a prominent disclaimer in their communications to investors, stating that the services provided are not under SEBI's purview and no complaints can be raised to SEBI.
trigger: When providing other services/raising invoices related to non-SEBI regulated activities
required_action: Provide a disclaimer in minimum 10 font size, prominently attracting the attention of investors
evidence: Copies of communications containing the disclaimer
verbatim_text: Part-time IA shall provide disclaimer prominently (minimum 10 font size) and attracting the attention of the investor while providing their other service/raising invoice related to other business/service that the activity/invoice is related to services not under purview of SEBI and no complaint can be raised to SEBI for the services rendered therein.

title: Disclose nature of other activities and ensure no conflict of interest
summary: Part-time Investment Advisers (IAs) must disclose the nature of their other business activities to clients, ensuring there is no conflict of interest between IA activity and other business activities or employment.
required_action: Disclose the nature of other activities and ensure no conflict of interest exists
evidence: Client engagement documentation showing disclosure of other activities and absence of conflicts
verbatim_text: The part-time IA shall disclose the nature of other activities to their clients and shall ensure that there is no conflict of interest between its IA activity and its other business activities or employment.

title: Provide clarity on eligibility for part-time registration
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide additional clarity regarding who is eligible for registration as a part-time IA, including examples and illustrations.
trigger: When registering or seeking clarification on eligibility
required_action: Provide explanations/illustrations of eligibility criteria
evidence: Documentation showing the provided explanations/illustrations
verbatim_text: For the purpose of providing additional clarity as to whether a person shall or shall not be considered eligible for registration as part-time IA, reference may be made to the following explanations/illustrations regarding other business activities or employment that a person shall or shall not engage in.

title: Identify ineligible persons for part-time registration
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must identify and exclude individuals who are not eligible for registration as a part-time IA based on the provided examples and illustrations.
trigger: When registering or seeking clarification on eligibility
required_action: Exclude ineligible persons from registration
evidence: Registration records showing exclusions of ineligible individuals
verbatim_text: Example/Illustration 2: Who shall not be considered eligible for registration as part-time IA? If a person is engaged in a business/activity of providing advice/recommendations on assets such as gold, real estate, cryptocurrency etc., it shall not be considered eligible for registration as part-time IA.

title: Determine the need to register as a part-time IA
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must determine whether they are required to register as a part-time IA based on the provided examples and illustrations.
required_action: Determine registration requirement based on provided criteria
evidence: Registration records showing determination of registration requirements
verbatim_text: Example/Illustration 3: Who is required to register as part-time IA? If a CA for the purpose of tax planning/tax filing provides advice/recommendation on securities as an asset class to its client as an incidental advice to its primary activity, it is not required to get registered as a part-time IA. However, if a CA is providing security-specific advice to a specific client, even though as part of tax

title: Designate Principal Officer for Partnership Firms
summary: A partnership firm registered as an investment adviser must designate one of its partners as the principal officer if no partner meets the minimum qualification and certification requirements.
trigger: Partnership firm is registered as an investment adviser, and no partner has the required qualifications.
required_action: Designate a partner as the principal officer or apply for registration in the form of a limited liability partnership or body corporate.
evidence: Form submitted to SEBI with designation of principal officer or application for registration change.
verbatim_text: Regulation 2(1)(s) of IA Regulations provides that in case of non-individual investment adviser being a partnership firm, one of the partners shall be designated as its principal officer. It further provides that in case no partner of the partnership firm registered as an investment adviser has minimum qualification and certification requirements provided under the IA Regulations, it shall apply for registration as an investment adviser in the form of a limited liability partnership or a body corporate within such time as may be specified by the SEBI.

title: Apply for Registration Change by September 30, 2025
summary: A partnership firm registered as an investment adviser must apply to change its registration form if no partner meets the minimum qualification and certification requirements.
trigger: Partnership firm is registered as an investment adviser, and no partner has the required qualifications.
required_action: Apply for registration in the form of a limited liability partnership or body corporate by September 30, 2025.
evidence: Form submitted to SEBI with application for registration change.
verbatim_text: Accordingly, a partnership firm registered as an investment adviser, where no partner of the firm has the minimum qualification and certification requirements provided under the Regulations, shall apply for registration as an investment adviser in the form of a limited liability partnership or a body corporate latest by September 30, 2025.

title: Appoint Independent Professional as Compliance Officer
summary: A non-individual investment adviser may appoint an independent professional who is a member of ICAI, ICSI, ICMAI or another specified body and holds relevant NISM certifications.
trigger: Non-individual IA needs to ensure compliance with SEBI regulations.
required_action: Appoint an independent professional as the compliance officer who meets the specified criteria.
evidence: Form submitted to SEBI with details of appointed compliance officer and undertaking from principal officer.
verbatim_text: In terms of Regulation 20 of the IA Regulations, a non-individual investment adviser may appoint an independent professional who is a member of ICAI or ICSI or ICMAI or member of any other professional body as may be specified by the SEBI, provided such a professional holds a relevant certification from NISM, as may be specified by the SEBI.

title: Submit Undertaking for Monitoring Compliance
summary: The principal officer of an IA must submit an undertaking to IAASB/SEBI regarding compliance monitoring.
trigger: Non-individual IA appoints a compliance officer.
required_action: Submit an undertaking to IAASB/SEBI that the principal officer will be responsible for monitoring compliance.
evidence: Undertaking document submitted to SEBI.
verbatim_text: In such cases, the principal officer shall submit an undertaking to IAASB/SEBI to the effect that principal officer shall be responsible for monitoring the compliance in respect of the requirements of the Act, regulations, notifications, guidelines, instructions issued by SEBI/IAASB.

title: Certifications Required for Compliance Officer
summary: A compliance officer appointed by an IA must hold specific NISM certifications.
trigger: Non-individual IA appoints a compliance officer.
required_action: Ensure the compliance officer holds the required NISM certifications.
evidence: Certification documents of appointed compliance officer.
verbatim_text: A non-individual IA may appoint such an independent professional as compliance officer who holds certifications from NISM by passing the following certification examinations- • NISM-Series-X-A: Investment Adviser (Level 1) Certification Examination, • NISM-Series-X-B: Investment Adviser (Level 2) Certification Examination, • NISM-Series-X-C: Investment Adviser Certification (Renewal) Examination, and • NISM-Series-III A: Securities Intermediaries Compliance (Non-Fund) Certification Examination

title: Scope of Investment Advice
summary: Investment advice related to securities under SEBI's purview falls within the IA Regulations, while financial planning services may include non-SEBI products.
trigger: IA provides investment or financial planning services.
required_action: Ensure that investment advice is related to securities under SEBI's purview and that financial planning includes non-SEBI products where applicable.
evidence: Documentation of provided services and their scope.
verbatim_text: In terms of scope of the ‘investment advice’ under Regulation 2(1)(l) of the IA Regulations, Investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI shall only fall under the purview of IA Regulations. It is however noted that IAs may also provide financial planning services to their clients and comprehensive financial planning may include the investment advice related to products or services not under the purview of SEBI.

title: Use Approved Investment Policy for Non-Individual Clients
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must use the investment policy as approved by the board/management team of non-individual clients for risk profiling and suitability analysis.
required_action: Use the investment policy as approved by the board/management team of such non-individual clients for risk profiling and suitability analysis.
evidence: Documentation showing use of the approved investment policy in risk profiling and suitability analysis.
verbatim_text: In case of non-individual clients, IA shall use the investment policy as approved by board/management team of such non-individual clients for risk profiling and suitability analysis.

title: Discretion to Share Investment Policy with Non-Individual Clients
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) have the discretion not to share investment policy/relevant excerpts of the policy if non-individual clients are unable to do risk profiling in the absence of an investment policy.
required_action: Have discretion not to share investment policy/relevant excerpts with non-individual clients if they are unable to do risk profiling in the absence of an investment policy.
evidence: Documentation showing decision-making process regarding sharing of investment policy.
verbatim_text: The discretion to share the investment policy/relevant excerpts of the policy shall lie with the non-individual client. However, IA shall have discretion not to onboard non-individual clients if they are unable to do risk profiling of the non-individual client in the absence of investment policy.

title: Maintain a Functional Website
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must maintain a functional website as per Regulation 19A of IA Regulations.
required_action: Maintain a functional website with details specified by SEBI.
evidence: Website URL and documentation showing compliance with SEBI requirements.
verbatim_text: In terms of Regulation 19A of IA Regulations, an investment adviser shall maintain a functional website, which shall contain the details as may be specified by SEBI.

title: Display Required Details on Website and Other Communication Channels
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must display certain information prominently on their website, mobile app, printed or electronic materials, client agreements, etc.
required_action: Display required details as specified by SEBI.
evidence: Website screenshots and documentation showing compliance with SEBI requirements.
verbatim_text: In order to protect the interest of investors and bring more transparency in the functioning of the IAs, the IAs shall display the following information prominently on its website, mobile app, printed or electronic materials, know your client forms, client agreements and other correspondences with the clients:

title: Confirm Website Details to IAASB by June 30, 2025
summary: Existing Investment Advisers (IAs) must confirm their website details to the IAASB by June 30, 2025.
required_action: Confirm website details to IAASB by the deadline.
evidence: Confirmation email or letter from IAASB.
verbatim_text: Existing IAs, as on January 8, 2025, shall confirm the details of its website to IAASB latest by June 30, 2025.

title: Restriction on Free Trial for Products/Services
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must not provide free trial of any products/services to prospective clients.
required_action: Do not provide free trial for any products/services.
evidence: Internal policies and procedures documents.
verbatim_text: Hence the IAs shall not provide free trial for any products/services to prospective clients. Further, IAs shall not accept part payments (where some part of the fee is paid in advance) for any product/service.

title: Proper Risk Profiling and Client Consent
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must complete risk profiling of clients based on provided information, obtain consent through registered email or physical document.
required_action: Complete risk profiling and obtain client consent as specified.
evidence: Risk profiling documents and signed consent forms.
source_clause: 2.2 Proper risk profiling and consent of client on risk profiling
verbatim_text: Risk profiling of the client is essential to provide advice on suitable product based on various criteria like income, age, securities market experience etc. Registered IAs shall provide investment advice only after completing the following steps: a. Complete the risk profile of the client based on information provided by the client. b. Obtain consent of the client on completed risk profile either through registered email or physical document.

title: Receive Fees Only Through Banking Channel
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must receive advisory fees only through banking channels to ensure proper audit trail.
required_action: Receive advisory fees only through banking channels.
evidence: Bank statements and records of fee transactions.
source_clause: 2.3 Receiving fees though banking channel only
verbatim_text: It is observed that the IAs are receiving advisory fee in the form of cash deposit in their bank accounts or through payment gateways which does not provide proper audit trail of fees received from the clients. To bring transparency in dealing with the clients, IAs

title: Accept Fees via Specific Methods Only
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must accept fees only through account payee crossed cheques, demand drafts, or direct credit into their bank accounts via NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI. They are prohibited from accepting cash deposits.
required_action: Only accept fees through account payee crossed cheques, demand drafts, or direct credit into their bank accounts via NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI. Do not accept cash deposits.
evidence: Bank statements and records of accepted payments.
verbatim_text: To bring transparency in dealing with the clients, IAs shall accept fees strictly by account payee crossed cheques / demand draft or by way of direct credit into their bank account through NEFT/ RTGS/IMPS/UPI. It is clarified that, IAs shall not accept cash deposits.

title: Display Complaints Status on Website
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must display the status of complaints received from clients on their website or mobile app, in a specific format.
required_action: Display the status of complaints received from clients on the homepage (without scrolling) of their website/mobile app. The information should be displayed properly using font size 12 or above and made available monthly.
evidence: Website screenshots showing the display of complaint statuses.
verbatim_text: In order to bring more transparency and enable the investors to take informed decision regarding availing of advisory services, IAs shall display the following information on the homepage (without scrolling) of their website/mobile app. The information should be displayed properly using font size of 12 or above and made available on monthly basis (within 7 days of end of the previous month) in a format as per Annexure C.

title: Segregate Family of Clients
summary: Treat family members as a single client for PAN purposes.
trigger: Presence of an individual client with dependent family members.
required_action: Reckon the family of clients as a single client and use joint and several control records.
evidence: PAN details of all family members.
verbatim_text: "In case of an individual client, “family of client”3 shall be reckoned as a single client and PAN of all members in “family of client” would jointly and severally be the control record. However, the same is not applicable for non-individual clients."

title: Identify Dependent Family Members
summary: Identify dependent family members based on income from a single entity.
trigger: Presence of an individual client with dependent family members.
required_action: Provide annual declaration or periodic update regarding the dependent family members.
evidence: Annual declaration or periodic update from the client.
verbatim_text: "The dependent family members shall be those members whose assets on which investment advisory is sought/provided, originate from income of a single entity i.e. earning individual client in the family. The client shall provide an annual declaration or periodic updation as the case maybe in respect of such dependent family members."

title: Advise Direct Plans Only
summary: Advisory services should be provided for direct plans only.
required_action: Advise on direct plans (non-commission based) of products only.
evidence: Records of advised products and their nature.
verbatim_text: "The IAs shall, wherever available, advise direct plans (non-commission based) of products only."

title: Annual Auditor Certificate for Segregation Compliance
summary: Obtain an annual auditor certificate confirming compliance with client level segregation requirements.
required_action: Obtain and maintain on record an annual certificate from an auditor confirming compliance with the client level segregation requirements as specified in Regulation 22 of the IA Regulations.
evidence: Annual auditor certificate.
verbatim_text: "The IAs shall maintain on record an annual certificate from an auditor confirming compliance with the client level segregation requirements as specified in Regulation 22 of the IA Regulations. Such annual certificate shall be obtained within 6 months of the end of the financial year and form part of compliance audit, in terms of Regulation 19(3) of the IA Regulations."

title: Waiver for Institutional Clients and Accredited Investors
summary: Exempt institutional clients and accredited investors from segregation requirements with a signed waiver.
trigger: Providing investment advisory services to institutional clients or accredited investors.
required_action: Provide a standard waiver stating that the client/investor is exempted from the segregation of investment advisory and distribution activities requirements.
evidence: Signed waiver agreement.
verbatim_text: "The IAs providing investment advisory services exclusively to institutional clients and accredited investors may not be subject to compliance with the requirements of segregation of investment advisory and distribution activities provided that the client/investor signs a standard waiver stating the above."

title: Stock Broking Not Considered as Distribution Activity
summary: Do not consider stock broking activity as distribution activity for segregation purposes.
required_action: Do not consider stock broking activity as a part of the distribution activity for the purpose of regulation 22 of IA Regulations.
evidence: Records indicating that stock broking is not considered a distribution activity.
verbatim_text: "Stock broking activity is not considered as distribution activity for the purpose of regulation 22 of IA Regulations."

title: Investment Advisory Agreement with Client
summary: Enter into an investment advisory agreement with clients.
trigger: Providing investment advisory services to a client.
required_action: Enter into an investment advisory agreement with the client, mandatorily covering terms and conditions provided in Annexure A and MITC as standardized by Industry Standard Forum in consultation with IAASB and SEBI.
evidence: Signed investment advisory agreement.
verbatim_text: "Regulation 19(1)(d) of the IA Regulations provides that IA shall enter into an investment advisory agreement with its clients. The said agreement shall mandatorily cover the terms and conditions provided in Annexure A and Most Important Terms and conditions (MITC), as standardized by Industry Standard Forum in consultation with IAASB and SEBI, provided in Annexure B5."

title: Include MITC in Investment Advisory Agreement
summary: Include the MITC into the investment advisory agreement.
trigger: Entering into an investment advisory agreement with a client.
required_action: Incorporate the MITC into the investment advisory agreement and disclose it to the client, taking their consent.
evidence: Signed investment advisory agreement including MITC.
verbatim_text: "MITC must include the following as terms and conditions:: ‘This agreement is for the investment advisory services provided by the IA and IA cannot execute/ carry out any trade (purchase/ sell transaction) on behalf of the client without his/her specific and positive consent on every trade. Thus, you are advised not to permit IA to execute any trade on your behalf without your explicit consent.’"

title: Client Consent for Agreement
summary: Obtain client's consent for the investment advisory agreement.
trigger: Entering into an investment advisory agreement with a client.
required_action: Ensure that the client consents to the terms of the agreement, which can be signed in person or through any legally acceptable mode including DigiLocker enabled Aadhaar based e-signature facility.
evidence: Signed consent form for the investment advisory agreement.
verbatim_text: "Consent of client to agreement between IA and client may be signed by the client in person or through any other legally acceptable mode including DigiLocker enabled Aadhaar based e-signature facility. IAs shall also provide guidance to their clients in the agreement on the optional ‘Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism for IA and RA’"

title: Disclose and obtain client declaration for non-SEBI products/services
summary: IA must disclose to clients that certain products/services are not under SEBI's regulatory purview, and obtain a declaration from the client.
trigger: Providing investment advice related to non-SEBI products/services
required_action: Make disclosure and take appropriate declaration and undertaking from clients
evidence: Client signed declaration and undertaking
verbatim_text: IA shall make disclosure to the client and take appropriate declaration and undertaking from the client that that such products/services and the services of IA in respect of such products/services do not come under regulatory purview of SEBI and that no recourse is available to them with SEBI for their grievances related to such products/services or services of IA in respect of such products/services.

title: Ensure compliance by existing clients as on January 8, 2025
summary: IA must ensure that existing clients comply with the disclosure requirements latest by July 31, 2025.
trigger: Existing client relationship as on January 8, 2025
required_action: Ensure compliance with the specified requirements
evidence: Client signed declaration and undertaking
verbatim_text: For existing clients as on January 8, 2025, IAs shall ensure compliance with these requirements latest by July 31, 2025.

title: Ensure security and confidentiality of client data using AI tools
summary: IA must be responsible for the security, confidentiality, integrity of client data when using AI tools.
trigger: Using AI tools in IA services
required_action: Ensure security and confidentiality of client data
evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation
verbatim_text: an investment adviser who uses Artificial Intelligence tools, irrespective of the scale and scenario of adoption of such tools, for servicing its clients shall be solely responsible for the security, confidentiality, integrity of the client data, use of any other information or data to arrive at investment advice, investment advice based on output of Artificial Intelligence tools and compliance with any law for the time being in force.

title: Disclose extent of AI tool usage
summary: IA must disclose to clients the extent of use of AI tools in providing investment advice.
trigger: Using AI tools in IA services
required_action: Provide disclosure regarding AI tool usage
evidence: Client agreement and additional disclosures
verbatim_text: an investment adviser shall disclose to the client the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing investment advice.

title: Provide initial and additional disclosures regarding AI tool usage
summary: IA must provide initial disclosure at agreement time and make additional disclosures whenever required.
trigger: Using AI tools in IA services
required_action: Provide initial and additional disclosures regarding AI tool usage
evidence: Client agreement and additional disclosures
verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall provide the disclosure of the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools by them in providing investment advice to their clients at the time of entering into the agreement and make such additional disclosure whenever required.

title: Maintain records of interactions with all clients
summary: IA must maintain records of all client interactions, including prospective clients.
trigger: Providing investment advice services to clients
required_action: Maintain records of all client interactions
evidence: Client interaction records
verbatim_text: IA shall maintain records with respect to his activities as an IA. In this regard, it is clarified that: a) IA shall maintain records of interactions, with all clients including prospective clients (prior to onboarding), where any conversation related to advice has taken place inter alia, in the form of: i. Physical record written & signed by client, ii. Telephone recording, iii. Email from registered email id, iv. Record of SMS messages, v. Any other legally verifiable record.

title: Maintain Call Recording of Client Consents for Implementation/Execution
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must maintain call recordings of every consent obtained from clients for implementation or execution if advice is given through a telephone call.
trigger: Providing implementation/execution services to advisory clients in the securities market via telephone calls
required_action: Maintain time-stamped call recordings of every consent for implementation or execution obtained from clients through a telephone call.
evidence: Call recording logs with timestamps and client consents.
verbatim_text: IAs providing implementation/execution services shall maintain call recording of every consent for implementation/execution obtained from the client if advice/execution is given through telephone call. All such communications shall have time stamped to maintain clear audit trail.

title: Maintain Records for Five Years or Until Dispute Resolution
summary: IAs must retain records of implementation/execution services provided to advisory clients for a minimum period of five years, extending until the resolution of any dispute or further intimation from SEBI.
required_action: Maintain records related to implementation/execution services for a minimum period of five years, extending until the resolution of any dispute or further intimation from SEBI.
evidence: Retention logs and records of implementation/execution services.
verbatim_text: IAs shall be required to maintain these records for a period of five years. However, in case where dispute has been raised, such records shall be kept till resolution of the dispute or if SEBI desires that specific records be preserved, then such records shall be kept till further intimation from SEBI

title: Conduct Annual Audit for Compliance with IA Regulations and Circulars
summary: IAs must conduct an annual audit to ensure compliance with the Investment Advisers (IA) Regulations, 2013, and SEBI circulars issued thereunder.
required_action: Conduct an annual audit to ensure compliance with the IA Regulations, 2013, and SEBI circulars issued thereunder. Submit a compliance audit report within one month from the date of the audit report.
evidence: Annual compliance audit report and certificate of compliance.
verbatim_text: As per regulation 19(3) of the IA Regulations, IA shall conduct annual audit in respect of compliance with SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 and circulars issued thereunder. Annual compliance audit report shall specify each of the provisions of the IA Regulations and the circulars and guidelines issued thereunder upon which compliance is reported.

title: Submit Annual Compliance Audit Report to IAASB/SEBI
summary: IAs must submit their annual compliance audit report and adverse findings, if any, along with the action taken thereof, within one month from the date of the audit report.
required_action: Submit an annual compliance audit report to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report. Submit adverse findings, if any, along with action taken thereof.
evidence: Annual compliance audit report and certificate of compliance.
verbatim_text: An IA shall - (i) complete the annual compliance audit within six months from the end of each financial year and submit a compliance audit report to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report. (ii) submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with action taken thereof duly approved by the individual IA or management of non-individual IA to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year;

title: Publish Annual Compliance Audit Report and Adverse Findings on Website
summary: IAs must publish their annual compliance audit report, including any adverse findings and the action taken thereof, on their website.
required_action: Publish the status of the compliance audit report and any adverse findings along with the action taken thereof on the IA’s website. Provide the compliance audit report to clients.
evidence: Website content showing published reports and findings.
verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

title: Submit Adverse Findings of Audit to IAASB/SEBI
summary: IAs must submit adverse findings, if any, along with the action taken thereof within one month from the date of the audit report.
required_action: Submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year.
evidence: Audit reports and documentation of actions taken.
verbatim_text: An IA shall - (ii) submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with action taken thereof duly approved by the individual IA or management of non-individual IA to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year;

title: Obtain Annual Certificate of Compliance from ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI or Auditor
summary: IAs must obtain an annual certificate confirming compliance with client-level segregation requirements.
required_action: Obtain an annual certificate from a member of ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI or an auditor confirming compliance with client-level segregation requirements within six months of the end of the financial year.
evidence: Annual certificate of compliance.
verbatim_text: An IA shall - (iii) maintain on record an annual certificate from a member of ICAI/ICSI/ ICMAI or from an auditor confirming compliance with client level segregation requirements. Such annual certificate shall be obtained within six months of the end of the financial year and form part of compliance audit, in terms of Regulation 19(3) of the IA Regulations.

title: Publish Annual Compliance Audit Report on Website
summary: IAs must publish their annual compliance audit report on their website.
required_action: Publish the status of the compliance audit report on the IA’s website.
evidence: Website content showing published reports.
verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

title: Provide Annual Compliance Audit Report to Clients
summary: IAs must provide their annual compliance audit report to their clients.
required_action: Provide the IA’s annual compliance audit report to its clients.
evidence: Client records showing receipt of reports.
verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

title: Publish Adverse Findings and Action Taken Thereof on Website
summary: IAs must publish any adverse findings of the audit, along with the action taken thereof, on their website.
required_action: Publish any adverse findings of the audit, along with the action taken thereof, on the IA’s website.
evidence: Website content showing published reports and findings.
verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

title: Submit Adverse Findings and Action Taken Thereof to IAASB/SEBI
summary: IAs must submit any adverse findings of the audit, along with the action taken thereof, to IAASB/SEBI within one month from the date of the audit report.
required_action: Submit any adverse findings of the audit, along with the action taken thereof, to IAASB/SEBI within one month from the date of the audit report.
evidence: Audit reports and documentation of actions taken.
verbatim_text: An IA shall - (ii) submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with action taken thereof duly approved by the individual IA or management of non-individual IA to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year;

title: Display Grievance Redress Mechanism
summary: IA must prominently display information about grievance redressal mechanisms in their offices.
trigger: IA operates an office where investors can access services.
required_action: Display the specified contact details and SEBI complaint mechanism.
evidence: Copies of displayed information or signage in IA's office.
verbatim_text: As an additional measure and for information of all investors who deal/invest/transact in the market, the IAs shall prominently display in their offices the following information about the grievance redressal mechanism available to investors:

title: Report Compliance with SEBI Circular
summary: IA must report compliance with the SEBI circular regarding SaaS solutions.
trigger: IA uses or considers using SaaS solutions for their operations.
required_action: Submit a half-yearly report to SEBI confirming compliance.
evidence: Half-yearly compliance report submitted to SEBI.
verbatim_text: The compliance of the advisory shall be reported half yearly by IAs to SEBI with an undertaking, “Compliance of the SEBI circular for Advisory for Financial Sector Organizations regarding Software as a Service (SaaS) based solutions has been made.”

title: Display Investor Charter to Clients
summary: Investment Advisers must disclose the investor charter on their websites and mobile applications, make it available in offices, provide a copy during client onboarding, and communicate via email/letters.
trigger: Change in control or when new clients are onboarded
required_action: Disclose the investor charter through various means as specified.
evidence: Website screenshots, office records, client onboarding documents, emails/letters sent to clients.
verbatim_text: All the Investment Advisers shall continue to disclose on their respective websites and mobile applications (if any), the data on complaints received against them or against issues dealt by them and redressal thereof, latest by 7th of succeeding month, as per the format enclosed at Annexure C to this circular.

title: Disclose Complaint Data Monthly
summary: Investment Advisers must disclose data on complaints received and redressed by them monthly.
required_action: Publish complaint data on the website/mobile application or other means as specified.
evidence: Monthly report showing disclosed complaint data.
verbatim_text: All the Investment Advisers shall continue to disclose on their respective websites and mobile applications (if any), the data on complaints received against them or against issues dealt by them and redressal thereof, latest by 7th of succeeding month, as per the format enclosed at Annexure C to this circular.

title: Obtain SEBI Approval for Change in Control
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval from SEBI before any change in control.
trigger: Change in control of the Investment Adviser
required_action: Submit a request for prior approval to SEBI.
evidence: Approval letter or acknowledgment from SEBI.
verbatim_text: Regulation 15(11) of the IA Regulations, IA shall obtain prior approval of SEBI in case of change in control.

title: Obtain prior approval for change in control
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must obtain prior approval from SEBI before any change in control.
required_action: Submit an online application to IAASB/SEBI for prior approval.
evidence: Online application with required information and declarations.
verbatim_text: IA shall obtain prior approval of SEBI in case of change in control.

title: Provide detailed information for online application
summary: IAs must provide specific details as part of the online application.
required_action: Submit required information and declarations.
evidence: Online application with all necessary documents.
verbatim_text: IA shall make an online application to IAASB/SEBI for prior approval. The online application shall be accompanied by the following information/ declaration/ undertaking about itself, the acquirer(s)/ the person(s) who shall have the control and the directors/ partners of the acquirer(s)/ the person(s) who shall have the control: a. Current and proposed shareholding pattern of the applicant b. Whether any application was made in the past to SEBI seeking registration in any capacity but was not granted? If yes, details thereof. c. Whether any action has been initiated/ taken under Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 (SCRA)/ Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (SEBI Act) or rules and regulations made thereunder? If yes, the status thereof along with the corrective action taken to avoid such violations in the future. The acquirer/ the person who shall have the control shall also confirm that it shall honour all past liabilities/ obligations of the applicant, if any. d. Whether any investor complaint is pending? If yes, steps taken and confirmation that the acquirer/ the person who shall have the control shall resolve the same. e. Details of litigation(s), if any. f. Confirmation that all the fees due to SEBI/IAASB have been paid. g. Declaration cum undertaking of the applicant and the acquirer/ the person who shall have the control (in the format specified at Annexure G), duly stamped and signed by their authorized signatories that: i. there will not be any change in the Board of Directors of incumbent, till the time prior approval is granted; ii. pursuant to grant of prior approval by SEBI, the incumbent shall inform all the existing investors/ clients about the proposed change prior to effecting the same, in order to enable them to take informed decision regarding their continuance or otherwise with the new management; and iii. the ‘fit and proper person’ criteria as specified in Schedule II of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 are complied with.

title: Obtain approval from stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories
summary: If the incumbent is a registered stock broker, clearing member, or depository participant, it must obtain approval/NOC from all relevant entities.
trigger: Change in control of IA and incumbent being a registered stock broker, clearing member, or depository participant
required_action: Obtain approval/NOC from all relevant stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories.
evidence: Self-attested copy of the approval/NOC submitted to SEBI.
verbatim_text: In case the incumbent is a registered stock broker, clearing member, depository participant, in addition to the above, it shall obtain approval /NOC from all the stock exchanges/clearing corporations/depositories, where the incumbent is a member/depository participant and submit self-attested copy of the same to SEBI.

title: File application within six months
summary: IAs must file an application within six months after obtaining prior approval.
trigger: Prior approval granted by SEBI for change in control
required_action: File an application within six months from the date of such approval.
evidence: Application filed with all necessary documents.
verbatim_text: The prior approval granted by SEBI shall be valid for a period of six months from the date of such approval within which the applicant shall file application

title: Obtain prior approval for change in control from SEBI
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must obtain prior approval from SEBI before making a proposed change in control.
trigger: Proposed change in control of an IA
required_action: File application with SEBI for approval
evidence: Application filed with SEBI and receipt acknowledgment
verbatim_text: The application seeking approval for the proposed change in control of the IA shall be filed with SEBI prior to filing the application with NCLT.

title: Obtain in-principle approval from SEBI for change in control
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must obtain an in-principle approval from SEBI after filing the application with NCLT.
trigger: Approval by NCLT is received for a proposed change in control
required_action: Submit online application to SEBI along with required documents
evidence: Online application submitted and receipt acknowledgment
verbatim_text: Within 15 days from the date of order of NCLT, the IA shall submit an online application in terms of clause 8.2 along with the following documents to SEBI for final approval:

title: Transfer shareholdings among immediate relatives without change in control
summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) can transfer shareholdings among immediate relatives without it being construed as a change in control.
trigger: Shareholding transfer among immediate relatives of an IA
required_action: No specific action required, but must ensure compliance with SEBI regulations
evidence: Documentation of shareholding transfer and confirmation from relevant parties
verbatim_text: Transfer of shareholding among immediate relatives shall not result into change in control. Immediate relative shall be construed as defined under Regulation 2(1)(l) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 which inter-alia includes any spouse of that person, or any parent, brother, sister or child of the person or of the spouse; Transfer of shareholding by way of transmission to immediate relative or not, shall not result into change in control.

title: Fit and Proper Person Criteria for Incoming Entities/Shareholders
summary: IA must ensure that incoming entities/shareholders satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.
trigger: Incoming entities/shareholders becoming part of controlling interest in the intermediary pursuant to transfer of shares from immediate relative/transmission of shares (immediate relative or not)
required_action: Ensure compliance with fit and proper person criteria.
evidence: Fit and proper person certificate, relevant documents.
verbatim_text: Incoming entities/ shareholders becoming part of controlling interest in the intermediary pursuant to transfer of shares from immediate relative /transmission of shares (immediate relative or not), need to satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.

title: Notice and Dissemination by IAASB/RAASB
summary: IAASB and RAASB must bring the provisions of this circular to notice of IAs and RAs respectively, and disseminate on their website.
required_action: Bring the provisions of this circular to notice of IAs and RAs and disseminate on website.
evidence: Notice sent, website update records.
verbatim_text: a) bring the provisions of this circular to the notice of the IAs and RAs respectively and also disseminate the same on its website; b) make necessary amendments to the relevant Bye-laws, Guidelines, Standard Operating Procedures, Rules and Regulations for the implementation of the above decision

title: Include Disclaimer in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must include a disclaimer stating that SEBI registration, IAASB enlistment, and NISM certification do not guarantee performance or provide assurance of returns.
required_action: Include the specified disclaimer in all advertisements and communications with clients.
evidence: Copies of advertisements containing the required disclaimer.
verbatim_text: "Advisories and communications/correspondences with clients shall include the disclaimer that “Registration granted by SEBI, enlistment with IAASB and certification from NISM in no way guarantee performance of the IA or provide any assurance of returns to investors.”"

title: Prohibit Certain Statements in Advertisements
summary: Investment Advisers must not include certain prohibited statements in their advertisements.
required_action: Ensure that the advertisement does not contain any of the specified prohibited statements.
evidence: Copies of reviewed and approved advertisements.
verbatim_text: "The advertisement shall not contain: i. Anything which is prohibited for publication under the law. ii. Statements which are false, misleading, biased or deceptive, based on assumptions or projections. iii. Any misleading or deceptive testimonials. iv. Statements which, directly or by implication or by omission, may mislead the investor. v. Any statement likely to be misunderstood or likely to disguise the significance of the same or any other statement contained in the advertisement. vi. Any statement designed to exploit the lack of experience or knowledge of the investors. vii. Any statement that is exaggerated or is inconsistent with or unrelated to the nature and risk and return profile of the product. ix. Reference to any report, analysis, or service as free, unless it actually is free and without condition or obligation. x. Any promise or guarantee of assured or risk free return to the investors. The advertisement shall not imply any assured returns or minimum returns or target return or percentage accuracy or service provision till achievement of target returns or any other nomenclature that gives the impression to the client that the investment advice is risk-free and/or not susceptible to market risks and/or that it can generate returns with any level of assurance. xi. Any statement which directly or indirectly discredits other advertisements or intermediaries or makes unfair comparisons or ascribes any qualitative advantage over other intermediaries directly or indirectly. xii. Reference to past performance or risk-return metrics in respect of the services of Investment Adviser unless such risk-return metrics are verified by Past Risk and Return Verification Agency (PaRRVA) and claims using such metrics are made in the manner specified by SEBI."

title: Obtain Prior Approval for Advertisements from Supervisory Body
summary: Investment Advisers must obtain prior approval from a SEBI recognized supervisory body before issuing any advertisement.
required_action: Obtain prior approval from the SEBI recognized supervisory body for all advertisements.
evidence: Approval letters or other documentation from the supervisory body.
verbatim_text: "Prior approval for the advertisement/material shall be obtained from SEBI recognized supervisory body."

title: Comply with Suspension Orders During Period of Suspension
summary: Investment Advisers must not issue any advertisement during the period of suspension by SEBI or a recognized supervisory body.
trigger: Suspension order from SEBI or a recognized supervisory body
required_action: Do not issue any advertisements either singly or jointly with other investment advisers during the period of suspension.
evidence: Documentation showing compliance with the suspension order.
verbatim_text: "In the event of suspension of any IA by SEBI and/or by SEBI recognized supervisory body, the IA so suspended shall not issue any advertisement either singly or jointly with any other IA, during the period of susp"

title: Prohibition on Advertising During Suspension
summary: IA shall not issue any advertisement during the period of suspension.
trigger: Suspension by SEBI or recognized supervisory body
required_action: Do not issue advertisements
evidence: Records of advertisement issuance and cessation dates
verbatim_text: of suspension of any IA by SEBI and/or by SEBI recognized supervisory body, the IA so suspended shall not issue any advertisement either singly or jointly with any other IA, during the period of suspension.

title: Prohibition on Engaging in Prize Distribution Games
summary: IA shall not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions etc. involving distribution of prize monies.
required_action: Do not engage in such activities
evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation
verbatim_text: The IA/RA shall not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions etc. which may involve distribution of prize monies, medals, gifts, etc.

title: Retention of Advertisement Copies
summary: IA shall retain copies of advertisements for a period of five years.
required_action: Retain copies for 5 years
evidence: Retention records and storage logs
verbatim_text: Copy of the advertisement shall be retained by IA for a period of five years in terms of Regulation 19(2) of the IA Regulations.

title: Transparency in Brand Name Usage
summary: IA must prominently display certain information on various platforms and documents.
trigger: Usage of brand name, trade name, or logo
required_action: Display required information prominently
evidence: Screenshots of displayed information, internal policies
verbatim_text: The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number and its complete address with telephone numbers shall be prominently displayed on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements. The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number, its complete address with telephone numbers, the name of the compliance officer, his telephone number and e-mail address, the name, telephone number and e-mail address of the grievance officer or the grievance redressal cell shall be displayed prominently in statements or reports or any other form of correspondence with the client. Disclaimer that “Registration granted by SEBI, enlistment with BSE and certification from NISM in no way guarantee performance of the IA or provide any assurance of returns to investors” shall be mentioned on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms, client agreements, statements or reports or any other form of correspondence with the client.

title: Prohibition on Using SEBI Logo
summary: IA shall not use SEBI logo.
trigger: Usage of brand name, trade name, or logo
required_action: Do not use SEBI logo
evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation
verbatim_text: The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number shall be prominently displayed on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements. SEBI logo shall not be used by IA.

title: Access to Mutual Fund Schemes Through Stock Exchange Infrastructure
summary: IA is allowed to use stock exchange infrastructure for purchasing and redeeming mutual fund units.
required_action: Use stock exchange infrastructure as per regulations
evidence: Transaction records, compliance logs
verbatim_text: Registered IAs are allowed to use infrastructure of the recognized stock exchanges to purchase and redeem mutual fund units directly from Mutual Fund/Asset Management Companies on behalf of their clients, including direct plans.

title: Prohibition on Circulating Unverified Information
summary: IA must put in place internal controls and code of conduct to prevent the circulation of unverified information.
required_action: Implement proper internal controls and code of conduct
evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation, compliance logs
verbatim_text: Proper internal code of conduct and controls should be put in place.

title: Prohibition on Encouraging Rumours or Unverified Information
summary: Investment Advisers must not encourage or circulate unverified information obtained from clients, industry, trade, or other sources without verification.
trigger: Employing workers in offices of market intermediaries
required_action: Do not accept or spread unverified information.
evidence: Verification logs and records of communication.
verbatim_text: Employees etc. employed/working in the Offices of market intermediaries do not encourage or circulate rumours or unverified information obtained from client, industry, any trade or any other sources without verification.

title: Restriction on Access to Blogs/Chat Forums/Messenger Sites
summary: Investment Advisers must either restrict access to such platforms under supervision or not allow access at all.
trigger: Employing workers in offices of market intermediaries
required_action: Restrict or prohibit access as per policy.
evidence: Access logs and policies.
verbatim_text: Access to Blogs/Chat forums/Messenger sites etc. should either be restricted under supervision or access should not be allowed.

title: Maintenance of Logs for Usage of Blogs/Chat Forums/Messenger Sites
summary: Investment Advisers must maintain logs as records for usage of such platforms.
trigger: Employing workers in offices of market intermediaries
required_action: Maintain logs as per IA Regulations.
evidence: Logs and records maintained according to IA Regulations.
verbatim_text: Logs for any usage of such Blogs/Chat forums/Messenger sites (called by any nomenclature) shall be treated as records and the same should be maintained as specified by the IA Regulations.

title: Forwarding Market Related News After Approval
summary: Investment Advisers must forward any market-related news only after it has been seen and approved by the Compliance Officer.
trigger: Receiving market related news in official or personal mail/blog
required_action: Forward news only after approval from Compliance Officer.
evidence: Approval logs and records of forwarded news.
verbatim_text: Employees should be directed that any market related news received by them either in their official mail/personal mail/blog or in any other manner, should be forwarded only after the same has been seen and approved by the IA’s Compliance Officer.

title: Compliance Officer Liability for Breach of Duty
summary: Investment Advisers must hold their Compliance Officers liable if an employee fails to forward market-related news after approval.
trigger: Employee failing to forward approved market related news
required_action: Hold Compliance Officer liable for breach of duty.
evidence: Compliance records and logs of forwarded news.
verbatim_text: If an employee fails to do so, he/she shall be deemed to have violated the various provisions contained in SEBI Act/Rules/Regulations etc. and shall be liable for action. The Compliance Officer shall also be held liable for breach of duty in this regard.

title: Principles for Outsourcing Activities
summary: Investment Advisers must follow principles for outsourcing activities as given in Annexure H.
required_action: Follow principles for outsourcing from Annexure H.
evidence: Documentation and records of adherence to principles.
verbatim_text: Principles for Outsourcing are given in Annexure H.

title: Prohibition on Outsourcing Core Business Activities and Compliance Functions
summary: Investment Advisers must not outsource core business activities or compliance functions.
required_action: Do not outsource core business activities and compliance functions.
evidence: Documentation and records of adherence to outsourcing policies.
verbatim_text: The intermediaries desirous of outsourcing their activities shall not, however, outsource their core business activities and compliance functions.

title: Compliance with KYC Requirements
summary: Investment Advisers must comply with the provisions of SEBI KYC (Know Your Client) Registration Agency Regulations, 2011 and Guidelines issued thereunder from time to time.
required_action: Comply with SEBI KYC regulations and guidelines.
evidence: KYC compliance records and documentation.
verbatim_text: Regarding Know Your Client (KYC) requirements, the intermediaries shall comply with the provisions of SEBI {KYC (Know Your Client) Registration Agency} Regulations, 2011 and Guidelines issued thereunder from time to time.

title: Reporting Suspicious Transactions/Reports to FIU
summary: Investment Advisers must report suspicious transactions/reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) or any other competent authority.
trigger: Carrying out activities with third parties
required_action: Report suspicious transactions/reports to FIU or competent authority.
evidence: Reporting records and documentation.
verbatim_text: Reporting to Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) - The intermediaries shall be responsible for reporting of any suspicious transactions / reports to FIU or any other competent authority in respect of activities carried out by the third parties.

title: Reporting Suspicious Transactions
summary: Investment Advisers must report suspicious transactions or reports to FIU or any other competent authority.
trigger: Carrying out activities with third parties
required_action: Report suspicious transactions/reports
evidence: Reporting records
verbatim_text: be responsible for reporting of any suspicious transactions / reports to FIU or any other competent authority in respect of activities carried out by the third parties.

title: Adhere to Conflict of Interest Guidelines
summary: Intermediaries and their associated persons must adhere to guidelines for avoiding or dealing with conflict of interest.
trigger: On the lines of Principle 8 of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulations
required_action: Adhere to these guidelines for avoiding or dealing with or managing conflict of interest, and educate associated persons.
evidence: Documentation showing adherence to the guidelines and training records for associated persons.
